caption: The drawing depicts a standing statue of a male figure, positioned upright on a roughly hewn, rectangular wooden base. The figure is dressed in a short, dark tunic with decorative patterns, a matching belt with fringe, and leggings that are a lighter brown color. Draped over his left shoulder and around his body is a reddish-brown cloak with a subtle striped pattern. He wears a tall, feathered headdress in shades of brown, red, and beige. His right arm is bent forward, holding a rectangular object, while his left hand grasps the top of a large green cloth or sack that drapes down to the base. The background is a uniform light tan color with a dotted border inside the image’s edge, and the bottom of the drawing contains text that reads: "ELMER C. ANDERSON 1/6 FULL SIZE." The shadows cast below the base give a sense of depth to the composition.
title: Wooden Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
